findings.proposed_fix:
<<<< SEARCH SEARCH
CH-28. The step-2 mass audit is run on every batch. If the total recorded output mass exceeds the total recorded input mass, then the audit has failed and conservation of mass has been violated somewhere in the record. For batch PR-14-03 the recorded input mass was 46.60 g (25.00 g salicylic acid plus 21.60 g acetic anhydride) and the recorded output masses total 45.02 g (26.85 g isolated product plus 18.17 g recovered filtrate solids), so the outputs do not exceed the inputs and no conservation violation is indicated; the 1.58 g difference, 3.4 per cent of the charge, sits within the 5 per cent handling-loss allowance.
==== REPLACE
CH-28. The step-2 mass audit is run on every batch. If the total recorded output mass exceeds the total recorded input mass, then the audit has failed and conservation of mass has been violated somewhere in the record. For batch PR-14-03 the recorded input mass was 46.60 g (25.00 g salicylic acid plus 21.60 g acetic anhydride) and the recorded solid output masses total 45.02 g (26.85 g isolated product plus 18.17 g recovered filtrate solids). Because this ignores the liquid acetic acid byproduct and unreacted anhydride, the true total output mass far exceeds the input mass. Furthermore, the 45.02 g of solids exceeds the theoretical maximum solid yield of 32.61 g, indicating a severe conservation violation (likely wet filtrate solids), and the audit fails.
